T7.3 Electric Fat Tire Golf Trike

About SoverSky T7.3 Electric Fat Tire Golf Trike Golf Mini Cart T7.3

[36+ Holes Golf Course] The 60V 20AH high-density lithium battery pack provides 35 miles of city range or combined stop-and-go range. SoverSky T7.3 has two battery box , it can carry 2 batteries ,make it 60V 40Ah making 36+ holes .
[Multi-Function] SoverSky T7.3 Three wheeler golf scooter is equipped with golf attachment , not only with the golf rack but also come with cooler rack making your golf more fun . .
[SMOOTH SPEED ACCELERATION] With 60V 40A integrated controller, Possess a good level of stability in power supply cotrol and high current output capability making the 3 speed up and down very smooth.It also has a reverse gear .
[PREMIUM COMFORT] The Hydraulic shock Fork and rear spring steel shock suspension are fully adjustable.. Besides the 10Inch tubeless fat tire decrease the risk of puncture and brake distance.
[ALL INFORMATION LCD SCREEN] Integrate the speedmeter ,mileage,voltage,power level together ,you can control your scooter all the time ,no worry for the low power any more .We also can diagnose faults by code which show in the display screen,make it easier for fix
